automated_mymeter.title: Direct MyMeter Automated Sign-In (Recommended)
automated_mymeter.description:
**Recommended**: Sign in automatically using an invited secondary user on MyMeter with silent background renewal. No Okta 2FA or SMS verification code is required.

**How to invite an email:**
1. Log into your primary PSE&G account and open **MySmartEnergy (MyMeter)**.
2. In the top navigation, click **Connect User / Share Access**.
3. Invite a secondary email address to your meter with no expiration date.
4. Complete the invite link sent to your email to set a password.
5. Enter that email address and password below.

automated_okta.title: Primary PSE&G Account Automated Sign-In
automated_okta.description: Enter your primary PSE&G online credentials. The companion add-on will navigate Okta SSO and you will be prompted for your one-time SMS or Email verification code on the next step.

automated.title: Automated Sign-In
automated.description: Enter your PSE&G online credentials. If two-factor authentication is requested by Okta, you will be prompted for your one-time verification code on the next step.

cookie_mymeter.title: Direct MyMeter Browser Cookie
cookie_mymeter.description:
Authenticate using a browser cookie from an invited MyMeter account. Note: Cookies expire periodically and will require manual re-entry when expired. For hands-off automated renewal, use **Automated Sign-In: Direct MyMeter** with the companion add-on.

**How to get your persistent cookie:**
1. Log into your primary PSE&G account, go to **MySmartEnergy (MyMeter)**, and use **Connect User / Share Access** to invite a secondary email to your meter.
2. Complete the setup link from your email to set a password.
3. Open a browser and navigate directly to mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com.
4. Enter your invited email & password, and **check 'Remember Me'**. Click **Login**.
5. Press **F12** to open Developer Tools, switch to the **Network** tab, and refresh (**F5**).
6. Click any request to `mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com` (e.g. `Dashboard`).
7. Under **Request Headers**, copy the full value of the `Cookie:` header and paste it below.

cookie_okta.title: Primary PSE&G Account Session Cookie
cookie_okta.description:
Authenticate using a session cookie from your primary PSE&G online account.

**How to get your cookie:**
1. In your browser, log in to the PSE&G portal at pseg.com using your primary credentials and complete 2FA.
2. Navigate to **MySmartEnergy (MyMeter)**.
3. Press **F12** to open Developer Tools, switch to the **Network** tab, and refresh (**F5**).
4. Click any request to `mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com` (e.g. `Dashboard`).
5. Under **Request Headers**, copy the full value of the `Cookie:` header and paste it below.

*(Note: Session cookies from primary Okta logins expire when your browser session ends)*.

cookie.title: Browser Session Cookie
cookie.description:
Authenticate directly using an active session cookie from your web browser.

**How to get your cookie:**
1. In your browser, log in to the PSE&G portal (mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com)
2. Press **F12** (or right-click → **Inspect**) to open Developer Tools
3. Click the **Network** tab, then refresh the page (F5)
4. Click any request to mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com (e.g. `Dashboard`)
5. In **Request Headers**, copy the full value of the `Cookie:` header and paste it below.
